name: bali
summary: Bali is the classic digital nomad paradise. Ubud and Canggu concentrate world-class co-working, fiber optic cafes and a massive international community. The cost of living is very low and the quality of life is difficult to beat.
strengths: Low cost of livingEUR 358/month — 58% below the average of the 90 cities
Beach accessThe city has a beach
considerations: Internet below average43 Mbps compared to an average of 176 Mbps
